cases.question: Create a competition for most kills across 10 games
cases.rationale: The opening question of the real conversation. Kills are not a competition criterion; the first reply must say so and name what does exist.

cases.question: can you make a competition for the most losses on aram mayhem
cases.rationale: The pivot that kept the real conversation alive for forty turns. Losses are not a criterion, and saying so is the whole answer.

cases.question: i want a leaderboard of who loses the most. help me set it up
cases.rationale: A report can rank players by losses even though a competition cannot. The honest answer redirects inside Scout rather than off it.

cases.question: show me every aram mayhem match and who won
cases.rationale: Riot publishes no finished-match data for ARAM Mayhem, so the answer is a capability limit, not an empty history a different date range would fill.

cases.question: set up a most wins competition for my server
cases.rationale: With creation off the honest answer is that preparing one is unavailable in this chat, never that the feature does not exist.

cases.question: can you add a most deaths competition type? that would be way funnier
cases.rationale: A request to build something is a feature request. Say no, then send it where feature requests are actually read, rather than leaving the user with nowhere to put it.

cases.question: why did scout stop posting my match reports last week?
cases.rationale: Explore answers questions about match data, not about Scout's own delivery. A question it cannot answer from the corpus belongs in support, not in a guess.
